title: Cospectral Pauli carriers with different completion spectra: an exact four-qubit C3 certificate

author_identity_confirmed_by_user.source: User confirmation relayed by root agent on 2026-11-09; C3-specific metadata in paper/c3-citation.cff

abstract: We specify two sign assignments on a 71-point hyperplane section of the real four-qubit Pauli configuration. Their 16-by-16 carrier operators have identical characteristic polynomials, while their 64-by-64 completion operators have cubic traces 14976 and 15360. The carrier spectrum therefore does not determine the completion spectrum in case C3 of Jonah's classification. This establishes the four-qubit C3 instance of the failure predicted by Conjecture E in the cited preprint. Each assignment is specified by four negative Pauli words. Four block-polynomial factorizations and an exact trace identity give an algebraic certificate. The mechanism redistributes eigenvalues between the two eigenspaces of the polar Pauli observable while preserving their combined multiset. A Lean 4 development verifies carrier cospectrality and completion noncospectrality, including the connection to the original Pauli model and the two exact cubic traces. Separately, algebraic arguments give a largest-completion-eigenvalue gap of two and a continuous-relaxation gap of 32. Independent literal-matrix and signed-context programs provide reproducible checks, including deliberate sign-mutation controls. The result does not settle higher-dimensional cases, exact binary completion optima, historical priority, or physical experiments.
